messages:
mohit: Hey — heads up, incident-bot didn't page during the 02:10-02:20 window. PagerDuty shows multiple triggers but no outgoing pages recorded. Anyone seeing the same?
liz: Confirming. I see PD webhooks received by notify-orch but delivery logs show repeated 502s to pager-proxy and then dedupe suppression kicked in.
incident-bot: [automated] Received 3 alerts for service=alert-orch, suppressed subsequent pages due to dedupe window (config: 5m).
dana: Manually escalated to the oncall group at 02:15 via PD UI — they acknowledged after manual page. Not ideal. :grimacing:
ben: Looking at the gateway logs now. There's a short spike of 502s from pager-proxy -> pagerflow at 02:11:10-02:12:40. After 3 retries the system marked alerts as duplicates and suppressed.
liz: Paste of relevant lines: ```2026-03-17T02:11:12Z notify-orch INFO trigger_id=abc123 pd_resp=502 retry=1
2026-03-17T02:11:25Z notify-orch WARN trigger_id=abc123 suppress=true reason=dedupe_window
```
mohit: Customer impact: Support flagged two customers (cust-17, cust-84) who reported missing pages for their monitors. One looks P1-ish; CS opened a ticket.
dana: Ops actions: I forced a manual re-send and confirmed PD delivered pages at 02:16. We need to get automated flow healthy before the next window.
ben: Quick mitigation: I'm going to reduce the dedupe window in prod from 5m -> 30s and bump retry policy to 5 retries with exponential backoff, then watch. Rolling patch now. Command: `kubectl -n infra patch cm notify-orch --patch '{"data":{"dedupe_window":"30s","pd_retries":"5"}}'`
incident-bot: [automated] Config change detected by deploy-bot; rolling notify-orch pods (3 -> 1 at a time).
ben: Patch applied and new pods in. Testing by replaying a webhook from staging-replay -> prod endpoint.
liz: Monitoring shows successful PD deliveries after patch. No more 502s in the last 2m. :thumbsup:
mohit: Great. For the post-incident work: please add an alert that fires when `pd_triggers > 0 AND pd_pages_sent == 0 for 60s` so we get proactive detection of silent suppression. Also capture the replayed webhook traces for the postmortem.
dana: Filed INC-2026-432 and added initial timeline notes. I'll own the comms draft with CS.
ben: Root cause hypothesis: transient pager-proxy upstream 502s + overly long dedupe window caused suppression of later retries. Will dig into proxy metrics (connection pool, circuit breaker).
liz: I'll update the runbook to include explicit manual escalation steps and the new short dedupe default. Also adding a validation test for webhook -> PD delivery in our chaos test suite.
mohit: Thanks all. We'll keep the incident open until we confirm no more missed pages in the next 2 hours and then convert to a postmortem. :eyes:
